name: Recital D
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text: ‘whereas banning access to reproductive care does not reduce the need for abortion care, but rather increases recourse to unsafe abortion, which has a negative impact on many areas of women’s and girls’ lives, including their fertility and mortality, or forces patients to travel abroad to obtain legal abortion care;’
